CustomField.description: CRITERIA RETIRE, NEVER DELETE - the claims-retire law reaching the criteria ledger, 8 August 2026. A criterion that should never have stood (the collapsed placeholder rows whose text was the literal word CRITERION are the first use) is marked here rather than removed: minting keys past it, projection never ships it, and the evidence of the mistake stays readable forever. The collapsed CR history corrects through this path per the twenty-seventh stamp: retire with reason, re-mint under the criterion's real name, never delete.
